amends.rule: v1 is retained unchanged as before-evidence; only the items below are superseded; every other term of v1 stands

A1_download_ceiling.basis: the 8,782-byte metadata response raised authoritative cumulative source bytes to 42,678,155 of 67,108,864
A1_download_ceiling.counting: every response body counts: HEAD (0 body), central directory, members, license, dependency wheels, redirects, errors and supplementary fetches

A2_response_authority.status: conditional: the A1 ledger's application-response cap is 12 of 12 consumed; no request below may be sent until Daniel records a new cumulative application-response ceiling for the A1 line; this amendment cannot enlarge that limit
A2_response_authority.requested_ceiling: 52 cumulative application responses (12 consumed plus at most 40 for this phase)
A2_response_authority.order: HEAD; central directory; license-first terms step (A3); stop or continue; member ranges; dependency wheels; construction; supplementary only on a named missing member

A3_rights_gate.adds: a pass/fail terms step before any operational member byte
A3_rights_gate.procedure: from the central directory select the smallest range containing the distribution's license file (robosuite-1.5.1.dist-info/LICENSE*, or a LICENSE member under robosuite/, whichever the central directory lists; if none is listed, stop) together with METADATA; fetch that one range first
A3_rights_gate.pass: the retained license text is a recognised permissive declaration that plainly covers the distribution (MIT is expected from the repository's declared license) and METADATA names it or names no conflicting terms
A3_rights_gate.fail: any other outcome stops the route before another member byte; the retained bytes, offsets, CRC32 and provenance are recorded either way
A3_rights_gate.scope: the declaration binds the fetched distribution members only; it is not extended to another version or to the repository

A4_identity_rule.supersedes: compatibility_criteria.C1_identity.check (wheel byte digest equals the pinned sha256)
A4_identity_rule.now: route A: the whole-wheel sha256 equals 39810a9e...; route B: the executed identity is the pinned URL, the sha256 of the fetched central-directory bytes, and a complete member table for the selection rule with offset, compressed and uncompressed sizes, central-directory CRC32 verified against the extracted bytes, and the extracted sha256 of every member; the publisher's whole-wheel sha256 is recorded as declared and unverified. C1 passes under route B iff every selected member is present, every CRC32 verifies and the table is complete; the other C1 terms (1.5.1 inside the runtime, every package pinned, the historical lock and environment byte-identical) stand

A5_reset_determinism_seed.now: C7 uses seed 900, checked unexposed on 2026-09-21 (its only appearance is an unrelated third-party test file); seeds 200-209 stay unexposed until E-200 starts; the probe still has 3 resets (1 probe, 2 determinism)
